rules: Clip each original GroundSurface and RoofSurface exterior to fixed evaluation rectangle in UV, linearly interpolating Z on edges. Same for all12. Under ground strict; each next upper boundary inclusive. Distance XY from evaluation rectangle. No learned model or GT used for boundary derivation.
